title: Opportunity Scorecard (v1.1.0)
description: The reconstructable output of the economics engine for one opportunity. Stores inputs-derived intermediates, sub-scores, composite, decision, and reasons so the score can be replayed by hand under its scoring_config_version. v1.1.0 (round two, additive): engine_version, config_hash, lane, yes_conditions, alert_checks, evidence, evidence_search, walk_away_price, min_quote_for_yes, and further derived fields (expected_revenue, branches, trips, fees, p_waste, travel_burden...). The derived object is open: every intermediate the engine computes is stored.

computed_at.description: Caller-supplied scoring time; the engine never reads the clock. Seeds scorecard_id.

config_hash.description: Content hash of the scoring-config file used; replay detects edits made without a version bump.

derived.description: Intermediate economic quantities (all in $ or hours or days).

ev_decision.description: EV after wasted-trip EV and confidence haircut.

weights_used.description: The weight vector applied (flip vs service), copied in for reconstructability.

reasons.description: Human-readable justification lines; must be sufficient to explain the decision.

pass_on_priors.description: R13 (C-05; amended C-06): true when decision is PASS and no failed gate is evidence-backed under its rule (flip economic gates: revenue side AND >= 1 cost-side input; other gates and services: >= 1 decisive input; evidence-backed = basis FACT or an aggregate marked evidence_backed from FACT evidence). The spine routes such a PASS to RESEARCHING instead of ARCHIVED (A-12). Always false for YES/MAYBE.

pass_basis.description: R13 audit (amended, C-06): per failed gate (or composite_floor) its rule, decisive_inputs[] (arithmetic inputs only; the ask price is evidence for the buy price, not an input), evidence_backed_inputs[], and for flip economic gates revenue_backed/cost_backed. The PASS archives only if at least one gate is evidence_backed.

yes_conditions.description: Step-2 YES conditions; all true (and all gates true) => YES.

evidence.description: Evidence checklist as evaluated (including derived items).

walk_away_price.description: FLIP: highest whole-dollar expected_buy_price that still scores YES.

min_quote_for_yes.description: SERVICE: lowest whole-dollar quoted_revenue that scores YES.

cheapest_decisive_evidence.description: For MAYBE-on-evidence: the lowest-cost missing item that would most move the decision (EVPI, §15).
